name: Update Center
author: Liam Beckingham
description: Every pending update in one bar panel (system packages, AUR, mise, plugins, and Omarchy itself), with a gentle reminder once you haven't updated in a while.

barWidget.description: Pending system, AUR, mise, plugin, and Omarchy updates, when you last updated, and a reminder once you're overdue.

schema.label: Remind after (days)
schema.description: Send a reminder once your last full system upgrade is this many days old and updates are waiting.

schema.label: Check for updates every (hours)
schema.description: How often to look for pending updates in the background. Opening the panel also checks.

schema.label: Repeat the reminder every (hours)
schema.description: While you're overdue, how long to wait before reminding you again.

schema.label: Check AUR packages
schema.description: AUR packages, via yay. Hidden when yay isn't installed.

schema.label: Check mise tools
schema.description: Tools managed by mise. Hidden when mise isn't installed.

schema.label: Show Omarchy separately
schema.description: List a new Omarchy release as its own line. Needs system packages to be checked.

schema.label: Show the update count on the bar
schema.description: Show how many updates are waiting next to the bar icon. Off keeps the icon a fixed width.

schema.label: Highlight the bar icon when overdue
schema.description: Colour the bar icon with the theme's urgent colour once you're overdue. Off keeps it in the bar's normal colour.
